headlines.title: U.S. imposes 50% tariffs on some Canadian goods after trade talks collapse
headlines.description: The U.S. imposed 50% tariffs on a wide swath of Canadian goods at midnight after trade talks between the two countries collapsed. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney responded to the tariffs saying, “Canada will match those tariffs dollar for dollar.”

headlines.title: Plane crash near remote radar site in Alaska kills 8 people
headlines.description: A plane crash in a remote region of Alaska has left eight people dead, including two U.S. Army Corps of Engineers employees. The crash happened at Cape Newenham Long Range Radar Site Airport, some 450 miles west of Anchorage.

headlines.title: Missing New York City grandmother found dead near airport in Las Vegas
headlines.description: The body of a missing 63-year-old grandmother from New York City was found near Harry Reid International Airport in Las Vegas, police said Friday.
